content.content: Bracket-close appends the (pre, post) pair in run order, moves the position to the pair's post-boundary, and clears the undone count, leaving the redo bound standing.
content.rationale: Order-visibility lives in marker order, so appending at close in run order makes file order the order operations ran in. The file is the ordered store the persistence claim provides. Closing also leaves the state where the run ended: the position moves to the pair's post-boundary, the undone count clears — the bracket supersedes the undone work — and the bound stands, so a later redo names the newer operation rather than nothing-undone (D15b) and a later undo starts its walk at the new end. The model's bracket effect is claimed here, not only in the model.
